simple.meaning: תִּירָס (Tîyrâç) is a Hebrew word meaning “Tiras , a son of Japheth.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: תִּירָס (H8494) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 10:2, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תִּירָס (H8494) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in תִּירָס (H8494) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: תִּירָס (Tîyrâç) / H8494 is traced through Genesis 10:2, 1 Chronicles 1:5 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
